name: turf-rush
description: 60 秒抢地盘：浏览器实时联机小游戏（2–4 人）

scripts.build: npm run build -w @turf/client && npm run build -w @turf/server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p client && tsc -p scripts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run sim
